title: Woman Standing Outside Bungalow, 1920s Sepia Snapshot, USA
description: A vintage snapshot featuring a modest single-story wooden house or bungalow with a front porch. A woman dressed in a patterned knee-length dress stands in the shadowed entryway. Handwritten in ink across the bottom margin of the front side is the phrase 'my happy home'. Surrounded by leafy trees and a modest yard, the image offers a personal reflection of American homeownership and domestic life during the late 1920s.
